nodes.label: NOTE: Full CLOB order placement requires Polymarket API authentication
25 Top Trader Laws
nodes.rationale: Hard-coded and cannot be overridden. A trade must pass 25 laws, a viability check, 12 analysis stages, and 25-agent consensus before it ever executes, protecting the $100 starting capital from bad trades.

nodes.label: Account Protection Modes (NORMAL/CAUTION/RECOVERY/DEFEND)
nodes.rationale: System automatically switches between 4 modes based on drawdown from peak, cutting the risk multiplier from 100% down to 20% as losses deepen, to prevent catastrophic account blowup on a small starting balance.

nodes.label: Railway Backend Deployment
nodes.rationale: Vercel cannot host the backend because Socket.io requires persistent WebSocket connections and Vercel serverless functions timeout after 10 seconds, so Railway (or Render) is used instead.

nodes.label: $100 Capital Allocation Plan
nodes.rationale: $100 is split across Polymarket (40%, zero fees), crypto swings (35%, low fees), long-term holds (15%), and a 10% emergency reserve that is never traded, diversifying across zero/low-fee venues while preserving a cash buffer.

nodes.label: Knowledge Systems (Master Knowledge Base, Strategy Library, Risk Rules Engine)
Security Architecture
nodes.rationale: JWT tokens (24h expiry) plus refresh rotation, bcrypt cost-12 hashing, rate limiting, CORS/CSRF protection, and audit logging form a layered defense for a system handling trading credentials and real capital.

nodes.label: Performance Optimization / Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: Multi-layer caching (browser localStorage/sessionStorage, Redis with TTLs scaled to data volatility, DB indexing/partitioning, gzip + pagination) targets sub-1000ms analysis execution and sub-100ms WebSocket latency.

nodes.label: New Intelligence Services (liquidity, correlation, earnings, options flow, sector rotation, intermarket, sentiment, social media, premarket, regime transition)
Microservices Architecture Principle
nodes.rationale: Each major feature is its own service, loosely coupled and highly cohesive, so it can be deployed independently — chosen for maintainability as the platform scales.

nodes.label: Fault Tolerance Principle
nodes.rationale: Circuit breakers, fallback strategies, dead letter queues, and exponential-backoff retries protect the system against flaky external market-data and broker APIs.

nodes.label: APEX TRADER Day 1-4 Integration Audit Report
Modern Light Theme Migration
nodes.rationale: Switched CSS variables from dark navy (#080C14 bg, #00D4FF cyan accent) to a light theme (#F8FAFB bg, #2563EB blue) for better readability, reduced eye strain, WCAG AA contrast compliance, and a more professional appearance.

nodes.label: Three Decision Paths (Fix Now / Build Now / Review First)
nodes.rationale: Path A (fix errors now, push, then build Day 3) is recommended over Path B (build in parallel) because a stable foundation reduces the risk of compounding errors during feature development.

6-Bucket Capital Allocation
nodes.rationale: Splitting capital into Crypto Momentum 30%, Stock Momentum 20%, Prediction Markets 15%, Options Premium 15%, Arbitrage 10%, and Cash Reserve 10% diversifies expected-return sources while keeping a protective cash reserve.

nodes.label: Go/No-Go Live Trading Criteria
nodes.rationale: GO LIVE IF Sharpe > 1.5 AND Win Rate > 55% AND Max Drawdown < 20%; otherwise stay in paper mode. A quantitative gate to avoid deploying real capital on an unvalidated strategy.

nodes.label: Prisma Type Generation Bug (UTF-8 BOM Schema Corruption)
nodes.rationale: The schema.prisma file was corrupted with UTF-8 BOM encoding characters, so the Prisma client cache was not regenerated after adding the AgentConversation/AgentLesson/AgentPerformance/AgentAdjustment models, causing 16 TypeScript compile errors.

nodes.label: Go/No-Go Decision (Sharpe/Win-Rate/Drawdown Gate)
nodes.rationale: IF backtest Sharpe > 1.5 THEN ready for live (after review); IF Sharpe < 1.0 THEN agents need retraining and system stays in paper mode.

nodes.label: 4-Week Implementation Plan (280 hours)
nodes.rationale: 280 hours spread across four weekly phases (services -> intelligence -> UI -> testing), sequenced so each week's output is testable before the next phase depends on it.

nodes.rationale: Dark navy (#080C14 bg, #00D4FF accent) risked eye strain and lacked a classic look; the new light theme (#F8FAFB bg, #2563EB accent) improves readability, professionalism, and WCAG AA contrast compliance.
